name: AWS Cognito
label: Amazon Cognito user pools Identity Provider API
description: Amazon Cognito Identity Provider API 2016-04-18 via OfficialApiNode, signed with AWS SigV4 (service cognito-idp). Docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito-user-identity-pools/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html. Operations: create-user (AdminCreateUser), get-user (AdminGetUser), list-users, update-user (AdminUpdateUserAttributes), delete-user (AdminDeleteUser), add-user-to-group, remove-user-from-group, create-group, get-group, list-groups, update-group, delete-group, get-user-pool (DescribeUserPool), listen. Auth secrets access_key_id, secret_access_key, optional session_token are instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen is kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. JDK HTTP, official API only. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_key_id, secret_access_key, or session_token here. Path params match api_spec.json placeholders. Example: {"operation":"create-user"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: create-user | get-user | list-users | update-user | delete-user | add-user-to-group | remove-user-from-group | create-group | get-group | list-groups | update-group | delete-group | get-user-pool | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen is ingress: no HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'create-user'.

schema.label: UserPoolId
schema.description: Pool id. Put on INPUT (body is not filled from config).

schema.label: Username
schema.description: Username or alias for user ops.

schema.label: GroupName
schema.description: Group name for group ops.

schema.label: UserAttributes
schema.description: Array of {Name, Value} for create-user / update-user.

schema.label: TemporaryPassword
schema.description: AdminCreateUser temporary password from a StudioQuack secret binding. Never logged.

schema.label: ForceAliasCreation
schema.description: Request-body parameter `ForceAliasCreation` for operation: create-user.

schema.label: MessageAction
schema.description: Request-body parameter `MessageAction` for operation: create-user.

schema.label: DesiredDeliveryMediums
schema.description: Request-body parameter `DesiredDeliveryMediums` for operation: create-user.

schema.label: ClientMetadata
schema.description: Request-body parameter `ClientMetadata` for operations: create-user, update-user.

schema.label: ValidationData
schema.description: Request-body parameter `ValidationData` for operation: create-user.

schema.label: Filter
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Filter` for operation: list-users.

schema.label: Limit
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Limit` for operations: list-users, list-groups.

schema.label: PaginationToken
schema.description: Request-body parameter `PaginationToken` for operation: list-users.

schema.label: AttributesToGet
schema.description: Request-body parameter `AttributesToGet` for operation: list-users.

schema.label: Description
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Description` for operations: create-group, update-group.

schema.label: Precedence

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Secret bytes in data must not be logged; bind them into StudioQuack secrets. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON from the official API. May contain secret material — never log; bind into StudioQuack secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: create-user, get-user, list-users, update-user, delete-user, add-user-to-group, remove-user-from-group, create-group, get-group, list-groups, update-group, delete-group, get-user-pool, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: AWS access key ID
configurationParameters.description: IAM access key ID used as the SigV4 credential. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: User pool ID
configurationParameters.description: Default UserPoolId for Admin* JSON body (official Cognito IdP API is POST / with UserPoolId in the body, not a path). Blank INPUT UserPoolId falls back to this config.

configurationParameters.label: AWS secret access key
configurationParameters.description: IAM secret access key used to sign SigV4. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: AWS session token
configurationParameters.description: Optional STS session token. When set, OfficialApiNode adds x-amz-security-token. Empty for long-lived keys. StudioQuack secret. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget (~300s).
